# Vendored compatibility asset

`One Dark Two.terminal` comes from:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mbadolato/iTerm2-Color-Schemes/master/terminal/One%20Dark%20Two.terminal`

The outer plist contains Apple `NSKeyedArchiver` color payloads that cannot be
produced portably on Linux. The generator copies this audited MIT-licensed file
verbatim and the release manifest pins its SHA-256 checksum.

SHA-256: `bad40772b87f7b20d5b127b2ff8a468a7e2bfccf87dc0a7e2ba1ec36bc47f1b1`

`one-dark-two-logo.png` is Beat Reichenbach's upstream 512×512 logo, copied
unchanged for editor-extension packaging.

SHA-256: `90d2c6f4468631016f30a93a51186119c99996f8b5145f2d97be79bfbe3dfec8`
